name: Haystack
label: Haystack
description: Official deepset Haystack Enterprise Platform REST v1 (search + file upload) and Hayhooks POST /{pipeline}/run. Default host https://api.cloud.deepset.ai. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key as Authorization Bearer (required on SaaS). Files use type file. Docs: https://docs.cloud.deepset.ai/docs/getting-started · https://docs.haystack.deepset.ai/docs/hayhooks. Terms: https://www.deepset.ai/terms-and-conditions. Never log api_key. Queries and files leave the host on SaaS.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. run_pipeline/query: queries (string array) or query (string), optional filters/params. index: files (type file) or text+filename. Hayhooks: pipeline name + body. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"queries":["What is Haystack?"]}.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Search string. Prefer queries array for SaaS body. Hayhooks often expects {"query":"..."}.

schema.label: queries
schema.description: SaaS search body queries: string[]. Example: ["capital of France"].

schema.label: files
schema.description: Platform file ref-id(s) for index / hayhooks_index. Never inline bytes. SaaS max 25_000_000 bytes each.

schema.label: pipeline
schema.description: Deployed pipeline name. Overrides config pipeline. Path {pipeline}.

schema.label: filters
schema.description: Request-body parameter `filters` for operations: run_pipeline, query.

schema.label: params
schema.description: Request-body parameter `params` for operations: run_pipeline, query, hayhooks_run, hayhooks_index.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: EXACT: run_pipeline | query | index | hayhooks_run | hayhooks_index. Default run_pipeline = SaaS POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace}/pipelines/{pipeline}/search. Hayhooks ops POST {hayhooks_url}/{name}/run on the self-hosted Hayhooks server.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: deepset Cloud API token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Required for SaaS. Hayhooks: the node always sends this header, so bind any placeholder value when the server has no auth. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Workspace
configurationParameters.description: SaaS path {workspace_name}. Required for run_pipeline, query, index. Overridable from input.workspace.

configurationParameters.label: Pipeline
configurationParameters.description: Deployed pipeline name (SaaS search or Hayhooks /{pipeline}/run). Overridable from input.pipeline.

configurationParameters.label: Index pipeline
configurationParameters.description: Hayhooks indexing pipeline name for hayhooks_index (path {index_pipeline}).

configurationParameters.label: Hayhooks URL
configurationParameters.description: Base URL of the self-hosted Hayhooks server used by hayhooks_run and hayhooks_index (scheme + host + port, no trailing slash). Hayhooks is not served from api.cloud.deepset.ai. Default http://localhost:1416 (the Hayhooks default port). Example: https://hayhooks.internal.example.com.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 120. Floor 1. Idle SaaS pipelines may cold-start.
